POST-MERGE VERIFICATION ON MAIN: THE FIX WORKS. Branch-head run 33840948374 at headSha 668523feffde (the fix commit itself) reports ALL FOUR pytest matrix cells GREEN:
  success  build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.11)
  success  build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.12)
  success  build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)   <- the cell that was failing pre-fix
  success  build-and-test / pytest (macos-latest, py3.13)
Every sweep tier is green too except the known-informational Windows one (py3.14, py3.14t, py3.15,
macos full suite, declared lower-bound resolution, external doc links all pass).

This is the real-time verification AC5 asked for, now confirmed on MAIN rather than only in a
worktree: the defect that was failing roughly 46% of CI runs repo-wide no longer reproduces on the
branch head. Closing this ticket earlier was correct, and this is the confirming datum.

The run's overall conclusion is still 'failure', from exactly two jobs, NEITHER of which is this bug:
 - scanner-integration -- bug 90c7, owned by another session, confirmed to fail on main itself.
   This is the sole cause of main's red conclusion.
 - sweep (windows) -- bug f850, continue-on-error and schedule-gated, so it cannot redden a run
   conclusion; informational only, and it has never passed since it was added.

So main's health signal is now attributable to a single owned blocker rather than a tangle.
